---
title: "Topics"
description: "Explore published writing by subject."
listing:
  id: topics
  # Starter categories are not editorial topics. Keep the posts in the archive.
  contents:
    - posts
    - "!posts/welcome/**"
    - "!posts/post-with-code/**"
  exclude:
    draft: true
  sort: "date desc"
  template: article-preview.ejs
  fields: [title, description, date, reading-time, categories]
  date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
  categories: unnumbered
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: true
page-layout: article
title-block-banner: false
body-classes: "editorial-page topics-page"
---

```{=html}
<nav id="topic-controls" aria-label="Filter writing by topic" hidden></nav>
<p class="topics-empty">No editorial topics have been added yet. Published writing is listed below; categories will appear as articles are tagged.</p>
```

::: {#topics}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Move the native controls into the reading column so they also work on mobile.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const sidebar = document.querySelector("#quarto-margin-sidebar");
  const categories = sidebar?.querySelector(".quarto-listing-category");
  const target = document.querySelector("#topic-controls");
  if (!categories?.querySelector('.category:not([data-category=""])')) {
    if (sidebar) sidebar.hidden = true;
    return;
  }
  target.append(categories);
  target.hidden = false;
  sidebar.hidden = true;
  const controls = categories.querySelectorAll(".category");
  const updateSelection = () => {
    const active = categories.querySelector(".category.active") || controls[0];
    controls.forEach(control => control.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(control === active)));
  };
  controls.forEach(control => {
    control.tabIndex = 0;
    control.setAttribute("role", "button");
    control.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        control.click();
      }
    });
  });
  updateSelection();
  new MutationObserver(updateSelection).observe(categories, {
    subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]
  });
});
</script>
```
